{{Top|leg}}
'''Asteroid crushers''' were massive ships that could be used to mine the mineral contents of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] within an [[asteroid field]]. They needed a large crew to function and could be used as a mobile base of operations for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] companies. In [[45 ABY]], the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] used an asteroid crusher, the ''[[Ormni]]'' as their mobile base within the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]].
